description: This is the source code for a custom Android AutofillService implementation named InlineFillService. It provides autofill datasets and inline suggestions for autofill forms, with logic for handling fill requests, save requests, and inline suggestions. The class includes methods to generate autofill responses, handle authentication, and configure inline actions and dialogs.

classes.name: InlineFillService
classes.description: A custom AutofillService implementation that provides dynamic datasets and inline suggestions, including support for authentication, inline actions, and fill dialogs.

methods.name: onFillRequest
methods.description: Handles fill requests by generating autofill datasets, possibly with authentication, inline suggestions, and fill dialogs, then sends the response via callback.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a FillResponse with a specified number of datasets, inline actions, a fill dialog, and save info.

methods.name: onSaveRequest
methods.description: Handles save requests; currently reports that save is not supported.

methods.name: onSavedDatasetsInfoRequest
methods.description: Provides information about saved datasets, cycling through a small set of mock datasets.
